column1: 23097§certificate§səˈtɪfɪkət§We provide a four-month certificate course, but you should be aware that this is designed for those who are employed.§我们提供为期四个月的**资格认证**课程，但是你要明白这一课程是专为在职人员开设的。§
23098§severe§sɪˈvɪə(r)§The research completed last year found that in the United States soil erosion was almost as severe as in India.§去年完成的调查显示，美国土壤侵蚀的状况和印度的一样**严重**。§
23099§diameter§daɪˈæmɪtə(r)§The diameter of the pipe is three inches.§这根管子的**直径**为三英寸。§
23100§gesture§ˈdʒestʃə(r)§Sometimes you may simply bow, or make no gesture at all, when you're introduced to a stranger.§在介绍你和陌生人认识时，你可以微微点头，也可以不做任何**动作**。§
23101§disclose§dɪsˈkləʊz§She didn't disclose the details on tax bills.§她未**透露**那些税收法案的细节。§
23102§sheer§ʃɪə(r)§Mary won the skating competition by sheer luck.§玛丽能在这次滑冰比赛中获胜**纯属**运气好。§
23103§successive§səkˈsesɪv§China's industrial exports went up for five successive years.§中国的工业出口额**连续**五年呈上升趋势。§
23104§balance§ˈbæləns§If you have a well-balanced diet, then you should be getting all the vitamins that you need for normal daily activities.§如果你饮食**均衡**合理，就会获得每天正常活动所需的所有维生素。§
23105§adjust§əˈdʒʌst§Research shows that older readers are having difficulty in adjusting to texts without pictures.§调查显示，年纪较大的读者比较难**适应**不带图画的文章。§改译文：原译「在阅读…时比较费劲」没译出 adjust to（适应），改为「比较难适应不带图画的文章」

23106§require§rɪˈkwaɪə(r)§Every house built near the airport requires the exterior walls to be double-brick to reduce noise.§所有建造在机场附近的住房都**要求**采用双层砖的外墙来降低噪音。§改例句：Every house 不能和最高级 nearest 连用，照译文「机场附近」改为 near
23107§fairly§ˈfeəli§I felt she hadn't treated me fairly.§我觉得她没有**公平**地对待我。§
23108§precise§prɪˈsaɪs§The company serves its clients with professional and precise attitudes.§该公司本着专业和**严谨**的态度为客户服务。§
23109§colour-blind§ˈkʌlə blaɪnd§People who are colour-blind may not be able to see the difference between particular colours.§**色盲**患者无法辨认某些特定的颜色。§改例句：may be not able 语序错，改为 may not be able
23110§trustworthy§ˈtrʌstwɜːði§Mr. Yang is an experienced and trustworthy guide.§杨先生是一位经验丰富且**值得信赖**的向导。§
23111§vomit§ˈvɒmɪt§The strange smell made her want to vomit.§这种奇怪的味道让她很**恶心**。§
23112§wrestle§ˈresl§The police officer tackled the man and wrestled him to the ground.§警方制服了那个男人并将他**摔倒**在地。§
23113§adolescence§ˌædəˈlesns§Adolescence brings about major changes in a young person's body and mind.§**青春期**给年轻人的身心带来巨大改变。§
23114§captivity§kæpˈtɪvəti§Animals bred in captivity would probably not survive if they were released into the wild.§**圈养**的动物如果被放生野外，它们将很难生存下来。§
23115§commerce§ˈkɒmɜːs§In the US, Washington is the seat of government and New York is the chief seat of commerce.§在美国，华盛顿是政府所在地，纽约是主要的**商业**中心。§
23116§condensation§ˌkɒndenˈseɪʃn§The essay was publicly recognized as a readable condensation of the recent scientific literature.§这篇散文被公认为是近期科普读物的**浓缩**通俗版。§
23117§facial§ˈfeɪʃl§I can not guess what he means from his facial expressions.§从他的**面部**表情我猜不出他是什么意思。§
23118§imprecise§ˌɪmprɪˈsaɪs§The witness's descriptions were too imprecise to be of any real value.§目击者的描述太**不精确**了，没有任何实际价值。§
23119§inactive§ɪnˈæktɪv§The volcano has been inactive for 50 years.§这座火山已经有50年**不活动**了。§改译文：原译「没有喷发」是意译，括不出 inactive（不活动的），改为「不活动」
23120§herbal§ˈhɜːbl§Herbal medicine is well recognized as a non-toxic treatment.§**草药**被公认为一种无毒害的治疗方法。§
23121§hover§ˈhɒvə(r)§It is August 15th in the Chinese lunar calendar and there is a full moon hovering in the sky.§今天是农历八月十五，一轮满月**悬**在夜空中。§改译文：原译「挂」（hang）不是 hover（悬停，盘旋）的意思，改为「悬」
23122§initiate§ɪˈnɪʃieɪt§The government has initiated a programme of social welfare policy.§政府已经在社会福利政策上**发起**一项新的计划。§
23123§longitude§ˈlɒŋɡɪtjuːd§Longitude means the distance of an imaginary line from the top to the bottom of the Earth.§**经线**是人们想象出来的从地球顶部到其底部的距离。§
23124§procrastinate§prəˈkræstɪneɪt§People were dying of starvation in the disaster area while governments procrastinated.§灾区的人们快要饿死了，而政府行动却**拖拖拉拉**。§
23125§rarity§ˈreərəti§Nowadays, men who do the cooking are something of a rarity.§现在会做饭的男人十分**稀少**。§
23126§seclude§sɪˈkluːd§The monks secluded themselves from the rest of society.§僧侣们将自己与世**隔绝**。§
23127§ongoing§ˈɒngəʊɪŋ§Manufacturers usually consider quality control to be an ongoing process.§制造商们通常认为质量管理是一个**不断发展**的过程。§

23128§feed§fiːd§To feed an increasingly hungry world, farmers need every incentive to use their soil and water effectively and efficiently.§为了**养活**世界上日益增加的人口，农民需要利用每一个激励措施来有效并且高效地使用他们的土地和水资源。§改例句：中文逗号改为英文逗号
23129§scenery§ˈsiːnəri§The scenery is as beautiful as a painting.§这里**风景**美丽如画。§
23130§stagnate§stæɡˈneɪt§Real wages have stagnated since that year.§实际工资从那一年开始就一直**停滞**不前。§改译文：原译「没再涨过」是意译，括不出 stagnate（停滞），改为「一直停滞不前」
23131§tap§tæp§Water from these subterranean lakes can be pumped to the surface and tapped.§可以将这些地下湖泊中的水抽出地面加以**利用**。§
23132§owe§əʊ§I owed the bank rather a lot of money a few years ago.§几年前，我**欠**了银行一大笔钱。§
23133§ministry§ˈmɪnɪstri§People can call the Ministry of Justice for free legal advice.§人们可以打电话到司法**部**进行免费的法律咨询。§
23134§individual§ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəl§The food is served in individual portions.§食物是按**一人**一份供给的。§
23135§association§əˌsəʊsiˈeɪʃn§Our long association with your company has brought great benefits.§我方和贵公司的长期**合作**已经带来了巨大的利益。§

23136§tempt§tempt§Some worry that governments and industries will be tempted to use the technology to monitor individual behaviours.§一些人担心，政府和企业会受**诱惑**而使用这一技术来监控个人行为。§改译文：原译「有意」不是 tempt（引诱）的意思，改为「会受诱惑而」
23137§beneath§bɪˈniːθ§Shall we have a rest in the shade beneath these trees?§我们在树阴**下**休息一下好吗？§改译文：原译「在树阴里」没译出 beneath（在…之下），改为「在树阴下」
23138§naturally§ˈnætʃrəli§Is extinction a naturally occurring phenomenon?§物种灭绝是一种**自然**发生的现象吗？§
23139§estate§ɪˈsteɪt§My accountant estimated the value of my estate.§我的会计师评估了我的**个人财产**值。§
23140§discourage§dɪsˈkʌrɪdʒ§Tom was discouraged from using the new car because of its bad assembly.§汤姆**打消**了驾驶这辆新车的念头，因为它的配置很差。§改译文：原译「不愿意驾驶」只能括到否定词，改为「打消了驾驶…的念头」以对应 discourage from（劝阻）
23141§candidate§ˈkændɪdət§These forms have to be filled out by the candidates.§这些表格需要由**申请者**来填写。§
23142§melt§melt§Salt helps melt ice.§盐可以使冰**融化**。§
23143§shrug§ʃrʌg§Joey and Monica looked at each other and shrugged.§乔伊和莫妮卡互相对视，**耸了耸肩**。§
23144§frightened§ˈfraɪtnd§The frightened child spoke in a halting voice.§这个**受了惊吓**的孩子说话结结巴巴。§
23145§relax§rɪˈlæks§Watching TV can help me relax.§看电视可以帮助我**放松**。§
23146§aerospace§ˈeərəʊspeɪs§This article is mainly about the applications of AI to aerospace.§这篇文章主要论述了人工智能在**航空航天**领域的应用。§
23147§suppose§səˈpəʊz§I suppose you're going to tell me the whole history of banana growing now, aren't you?§我**猜**你是打算现在给我讲解香蕉种植的整个历史，对吗？§
23148§tenable§ˈtenəbl§Tom thought his approach was tenable.§汤姆认为他的方法是**站得住脚**的。§
23149§sustain§səˈsteɪn§Thousands of lakes are so polluted that they can no longer sustain fish life.§数千个湖泊受到非常严重的污染，已无法再**维持**鱼类的生存。§
23150§straw§strɔː§Agnes has a wheelbarrow full of straw and manure.§阿格尼丝有满满一推车的**稻草**和肥料。§
23151§border§ˈbɔːdə(r)§We passed the border into Mexico.§我们穿越**边境**进入了墨西哥。§
23152§dispenser§dɪˈspensə(r)§Japan's largest maker of cash dispensers is developing new machines that incorporate iris scanners.§日本最大的**提款机**制造商正在开发配有虹膜扫描仪的新机器。§
23153§receiver§rɪˈsiːvə(r)§He put his hand over the receiver in order to get the signal better.§他将手放到**接收器**上以便收到更清晰的信号。§
23154§monopoly§məˈnɒpəli§In some countries, stamps are a government monopoly.§在一些国家，邮票为政府**垄断品**。§
23155§bureaucracy§bjʊəˈrɒkrəsi§Since you hate bureaucracy, you must learn to work with bureaucracy to save it from itself.§既然你们痛恨**官僚主义**，那你们就必须学会与官僚主义共事，只有这样才能将其克服。§
23156§construction§kənˈstrʌkʃn§They spent years completing the construction of the new airport.§他们花了数年的时间才**建**成新机场。§
23157§endorse§ɪnˈdɔːs§The socio-ecological view of health was endorsed at the first International Conference of Health Promotion.§关于健康的社会生态学观点在第一届世界健康促进会上得到了**认可**。§
23158§membership§ˈmembəʃɪp§You can pay the membership fee by cheque.§你可以用支票交**会员**费。§
23159§embryo§ˈembriəʊ§Two American researchers studied the brains of human embryos and discovered that the left-right asymmetry exists before birth.§两位美国研究人员在对人类**胚胎**的大脑进行研究后发现，左右脑不对称的现象在出生前就存在。§
23160§intelligence§ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns§The scientists are using genetics to improve the intelligence of mice.§科学家们正在利用基因技术提高老鼠的**智力**。§
23161§mature§məˈtʃʊə(r)§Jane is very mature for her age.§简年龄不大，却很**成熟**。§
23162§discard§dɪˈskɑːd§10% of the data was discarded as unreliable.§10%的数据因不可靠而被**废弃**。§
23163§roast§rəʊst§Roast dinner sounds ordinary but it is really tasty.§**烧烤**大餐听起来很普通，但味道的确很好。§
23164§assault§əˈsɔːlt§With the recent increase in sexual assaults, the police have taken action to curb the crime and protect women.§随着近来性**攻击**事件的增加，警方已采取措施遏制犯罪，保护女性。§

23165§predator§ˈpredətə(r)§To avoid being taken over by their counterpart predator, the company has made great effort and got fully prepared.§为了免遭同行**掠夺者**的接管，公司已经做了充分的准备工作。§改例句：got fully preparation 语法错，改为 got fully prepared；改译文：原译「强敌」不是 predator（掠夺者）的意思，改为「同行掠夺者」
